subject: Post-demo: action items & confirmation of decision criteria
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medicohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap and open items — deployment & SLA targets

Hi Elena — thanks again for making time today. Quick recap and the open asks we agreed to: 

1) Decision criteria (please confirm):
- Latency target: p95 inference latency at or below 200ms for the patient-facing workflow (you mentioned 150–200ms as acceptable)
- Cost: target to be within your budget band — you flagged OPEX preference, want a rough $/1k-token benchmark before procurement
- Deployment mode: preference for a hosted API initially, but procurement/security asked about Dedicated or Private for PHI-sensitive pipelines
- SLA: availability SLA requirement (you said enterprise SLA with incident escalation) — please confirm exact uptime/SLA threshold if you have one

2) Stakeholder map (please confirm roles & owners):
- Economic buyer: Marcus Lin (you mentioned he’s the final approver)
- Procurement lead: (need name) — likely to be looped for contract terms
- Security/compliance: head of InfoSec (they’ll want SOC 2 and data residency language)

3) Next steps we promised: 
- I’ll send a short MAP (mutual action plan) and a pricing estimate that shows Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private delta.
- Marissa and Neha are on deck to produce architecture comparatives and a procurement checklist.
- We’ll surface SOC2 scope and example security evidence (audit logs, retention controls).

Attachments: redwood-post-demo-deck.pdf (slides we walked through)

Open asks for you to confirm back in a reply: economic buyer confirmed (name + email), expected procurement timeline (weeks), and any non-negotiable security requirements (e.g., on-prem only for PHI).

If convenient, I can book a 30-min follow-up next week to align on MAP and pricing — otherwise reply with the details above.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
-----

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medicohealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap and open items — deployment & SLA targets

David — quick answers inline: 

Decision criteria confirmation:
- Latency: target p95 180ms across the patient triage path (we can tolerate up to 200ms for occasional spikes).
- Cost: procurement will want a clear $/1k-token comparison; they prefer predictable monthly commits if the delta vs hosted is reasonable.
- Deployment: initial preference is hosted for speed-to-production; InfoSec will evaluate Dedicated/Private for PHI pipelines.
- SLA: Marcus will expect enterprise SLA (99.9%); security will want RTO/RPO guidance for incidents.

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@medicohealth.com> (COO) — he signs off on T&Cs and budget.
- Procurement: Tessa Morgan (procurement) — I’ll confirm her email tomorrow.
- Security: Raj Patel (Head of InfoSec) — expects SOC 2 and data-residency assurances.

Timeline: procurement likely needs 3–6 weeks once we give baseline pricing and a short MAP.

Please send the MAP + price compare. Also include a short note on what falls under our data residency controls if we move to Dedicated/Private.

Elena
--
Elena Soto
Director, Product Operations | MedicoHealth
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@medicohealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap and open items — action items for pricing/MAP/security

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Elena’s confirmation. Ask: can you own the following?

1) Marissa: produce a 1-page MAP (timeline + owners) and a 1-page pricing comparator (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) that highlights predictable monthly commit scenarios and ballpark $/1k-token ranges. Attach suggested contract SLAs and standard exceptions. Aim for the first draft by EOD Friday.

2) Neha: produce a short security evidence packet (SOC2 scope summary, retention/audit-log description, data-residency options and what we can offer for Dedicated/Private) + a technical note on how we support PHI workflows.

3) I’ll draft an intro email to Marcus and procurement once we have those two docs. Also flagging SRE for a quick latency feasibility check — can we commit to p95 <= 180ms on Dedicated for the target model with moderate batching? If not, provide tradeoffs.

Thanks — want to keep momentum (procurement timeline is 3–6 weeks per Elena).

David
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo recap and open items — action items for pricing/MAP/security

Thanks — taking point on MAP + pricing. Notes:
- Draft MAP attached as MAP-draft.docx (owners + milestones).
- Quick pricing note: hosted baseline shows lower ramp cost but higher variable; Dedicated with a 3-month commit reduces unit cost ~30% for the volumes Elena hinted at. I added a conservative $/1k-token row in pricing-estimate.csv (attached).
- Latency: had a quick sync with infra — Dedicated on A100-class with our recommended quantization profile should hit p95 ~140–180ms depending on prompt length. We’ll get a short SRE note for Neha to include.

Planned deliverables: MAP + pricing + SRE latency note + Neha’s security packet by EOD Friday. If SRE flags any blockers, we’ll highlight tradeoffs (e.g., smaller context lengths, batching knobs).

Marissa
